name: Emotion-sharing community with AI comforting messages

mentions.name: Emotion-sharing community with AI comforting messages
mentions.description: A web community where people honestly share their emotions and empathize with others' feelings without comments. Users receive a comforting message generated by AI based on emotion analysis of their text, emojis, and chosen colors. Designed for Korean users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m currently creating a simple community where people can honestly share their emotions and empathize with others’ feelings (without comments).
It’s a web community where users can receive a comforting message from AI based on emotion analysis of their text, emojis, and chosen colors.
